cohort: The study included 583 women with a history of first venous thromboembolism occurring during pregnancy or up to 3 months after delivery, who were referred to La Timone Hospital in Marseille, France.
finding: Although the recurrence risk for VTE is low within the first 10 years after a pregnancy-associated VTE, one-third of patients experienced a new event over a 30-year period, with interrupted pregnancies, lower limb DVT, and AB blood group associated with higher risk.
